headline: Puig reports 5.6% third-quarter sales growth led by fragrances
summary: Puig reported a 5.6% increase in third-quarter sales, driven by strong growth in niche fragrances, makeup, dermocosmetics, and the Asia-Pacific region.
why: Puig is a multinational beauty and fashion company that manages a portfolio of premium fragrance and cosmetic brands.

impacts.name: Luxury & Consumer Goods
impacts.why: Solid quarterly sales expansion indicates healthy consumer demand within the premium personal care sector.
